mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_group_members ( study_group_id, user_id, status, notification_read_yn, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{studyGroup.id}, #{user.id}, #{status}, #{notificationReadYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE study_group_members SET status = #{status}, notification_read_yn = #{notificationReadYn}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT M.id, M.study_group_id AS `studyGroup.id`, M.user_id AS `user.id`, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at FROM study_group_members M WHERE M.id = #{id}

SELECT M.id, M.study_group_id AS `studyGroup.id`, M.user_id AS `user.id`, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at FROM study_group_members M WHERE M.study_group_id = #{studyGroupId} AND M.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT M.id, M.study_group_id AS `studyGroup.id`, M.user_id AS `user.id`, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at FROM study_group_members M WHERE M.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT M.id, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at, SG.id AS `studyGroup.id`, SG.title AS `studyGroup.title`, SG.category AS `studyGroup.category`, SG.study_method AS `studyGroup.studyMethod`, SG.region AS `studyGroup.region`, SG.place AS `studyGroup.place`, SG.capacity AS `studyGroup.capacity`, SG.current_members AS `studyGroup.currentMembers`, SG.recruitment_status AS `studyGroup.recruitmentStatus`, SG.difficulty AS `studyGroup.difficulty`, SG.meeting_days AS `studyGroup.meetingDays`, SG.meeting_time AS `studyGroup.meetingTime`, SG.duration AS `studyGroup.duration`, SG.goal AS `studyGroup.goal`, SG.participation_requirements AS `studyGroup.participationRequirements`, SG.description AS `studyGroup.description`, SG.contact_link AS `studyGroup.contactLink`, U.id AS `studyGroup.owner.id`, U.nickname AS `studyGroup.owner.nickname` FROM study_group_members M INNER JOIN study_groups SG ON SG.id = M.study_group_id INNER JOIN users U ON U.id = SG.owner_id WHERE M.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY M.id DESC

SELECT M.id, M.study_group_id AS `studyGroup.id`, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at, U.id AS `user.id`, U.login_id AS `user.loginId`, U.nickname AS `user.nickname` FROM study_group_members M INNER JOIN users U ON U.id = M.user_id WHERE M.study_group_id = #{studyGroupId} AND M.status = #{status} ORDER BY M.id ASC

SELECT M.id, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at, SG.id AS `studyGroup.id`, SG.title AS `studyGroup.title`, U.id AS `user.id`, U.nickname AS `user.nickname` FROM study_group_members M INNER JOIN study_groups SG ON SG.id = M.study_group_id INNER JOIN users U ON U.id = M.user_id WHERE SG.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND M.status = #{status} ORDER BY M.created_at DESC

SELECT M.id, M.status, M.notification_read_yn, M.created_at, M.updated_at, SG.id AS `studyGroup.id`, U.id AS `user.id` FROM study_group_members M INNER JOIN study_groups SG ON SG.id = M.study_group_id INNER JOIN users U ON U.id = M.user_id WHERE SG.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND M.status = #{status} AND M.notification_read_yn = #{notificationReadYn}
